featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an outstanding experience with Anmol Jewellers during a recent trip to Mumbai. Komal and Bhabika looked after us from start to finish, and they were exceptional. I needed two custom wedding bands, one ladies and one gents, as well as a diamond engagement ring. I arrived in Mumbai with the designs, and Anmol created all three pieces within about four weeks. The final result was exactly as drawn and even better than I expected.

They sourced a high quality diamond for the engagement ring at an excellent price. It was noticeably better in both price and quality than what we were shown elsewhere, including at Tashniq and Popley’s. The team were proactive and rang their suppliers while we were there so we could compare options on the spot. As a foreigner without an Indian card, I also appreciated that they happily accommodated a bank transfer as the payment method.

Komal and Bhabika were consistently kind, attentive and relaxed. They offered food and drinks, took their time with us, and never pushed for a sale. That was a real contrast to some of the other stores we visited. When the rings were ready, I was taken to the staff room to inspect the GIA certificate and the diamond itself. The craftsmanship was excellent, and the rings matched the original designs perfectly. Anmol even charged less than the initial estimate because the final pieces required less gold, which we thought was very honest.

Thanks to Anmol, we now have a beautifully matched custom ring set, high quality stones and workmanship, and a very fair price. They also have a wide range of other stunning jewellery if you are looking for something more elaborate. I would recommend Anmol to anyone wanting beautiful pieces and genuinely great service.

featured_reviews.review_text: I am getting married and for my marriage i chose to go to kalyan jewellers goregaon west. And i went there 1 day prior to preselect everything and finalise the amount. I went there again the next day. And the price that they agreed was drastically changed overnight for absolute no reason. Then after spending 4 hrs of negotiation the manager himself wrote a price amount and told me that its final or reduce the items. Since I didnt feel the amount right, I removed a pair of earrings. Even after that the price they gave was too much. We agreed to pay. After agreeing to pay when we reached the counter(exactly after 2.5 seconds),  they increased the price. And then I argued with them. I called the manager and gave him an earful but the USELESS AND GOOD-FOR-NOTHING MANAGER put the blame on staff and quietly left. This whole experience was so shameful. I had to yell at the poor staff and the staff somehow convinced me to pay the full amount as they were asking. When my partner when to make the payment, again the staff informed me that the price has again magically increased. I spent almost 6 hrs there and in the end I lost my temper. After that the staff cried and told me to pay the remaining or else the manager will cut it from her salary. I felt pity on her and I again paid the price they were asking. And the manager wanted nothing to do with this matter. I have never met such arrogant and useless person in my life! He should be FIRED!!!!! As a bride to be, i had to go through so much pain, anger and tears for this. I would recommend all the brides to be to not visit the store, if u dont want an unpleasant experience!!!

My fiancé and I purchased our engagement ring from Waman Hari Pethe (R City branch), Unfortunately, less than a year later, a diamond fell out of the ring. featured_reviews.review_text:
A beautiful blend of art, culture, beauty, ethos and India...Razia Kunj is a brand that stands for all this and more.
She is an artist par excellence who creates the most magnificent pieces of jewelry. She pours her heart into her work and it reflects in each and every piece of her creations.
The most unique part about her jewelry is that every piece narrates a story, a legend.
I absolutely love adorning Razia Kunj labelled jewelry. The colours, designs, patterns, details and story attached to it is something that makes her work stand apart.
I would recommend everyone to own a Razia Kunj piece of art! You sure wouldn't want to miss out.

featured_reviews.name: leena purav
featured_reviews.review_text:
I love her jewellery and is strongly recommended.

Razia Kunj is one of the best jewellery designers I know. Every piece is meticulously handcrafted, creating a unique and breathtaking work of art. They're not just a piece of classic statement jewellery, but a story unfolding before your eyes.

Over the past few years, I now own about eight pieces of it and I'm constantly impressed by the customer service and the quality delivered.
The packing is wonderful for storing and comes with a small note that gives a brief history of the design.

featured_reviews.name: Shilpa Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: Razia Kunj’s jewellery is just stunningly beautiful. Each piece tells a story of years gone by... when you buy a piece, you are buying wearable art really! Also, it all comes so beautifully packed, with a little note and a story telling a story from our culture & roots,  that it just makes the piece so much more special. Couldn’t recommend it enough - whether it’s for yourself or as a present to a loved one....

featured_reviews.name: Vinod Sasi
featured_reviews.review_text: Razia is an amazing artist and her love for art can be seen in each and every jewellery she creates. Each piece of the jewellery illustrates extraordinary combination of art, culture and tradition (you have to own it to believe it). My personal favourite is the Thandav Bracelet which I cannot part with as its very very close to my heart. A warm hug to Razia and her team for the professionalism and support. All the best and keep up the excellent work of art.

featured_reviews.name: Shabana Mohamed Shani
featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely in love with their art.
